caption:
ETIAS is not live yet. Anyone charging you for it today is running a scam.

We see this weekly. A convincing website, an official-looking logo, a payment form, and a fee for something that does not exist yet.

When it does launch, the only place to apply will be the official EU channel. Before you pay for any travel authorisation, trace the site back to a government source.

slides.headline: ETIAS IS NOT LIVE YET.
slides.sub: Anyone charging you for it is taking your money.
slides.note: Convincing website. Official-looking logo. Payment form. A fee for something that does not exist yet.

slides.answer: YOU CANNOT APPLY FOR IT TODAY.
slides.body: Not through us, not through anyone. When it launches, the only legitimate route will be the official EU channel.
slides.note: Every site processing ETIAS applications right now is taking payment for nothing.

slides.headline: HOW TO SPOT THE FAKE
items: It asks for payment for something not yet in force
The domain traces to no government or official partner
It promises instant approval or guaranteed entry
It pressures you to pay today
Contact details are a form and nothing else

slides.headline: TRACE IT BACK BEFORE YOU PAY
slides.body: Official travel authorisations are issued through official channels. If a site cannot be traced to a government source or a named licensed agency, it does not deserve your card details.
slides.takeaway: One minute of scepticism saves a great deal.
